description: Create a Saudi e-invoice and run the available ZATCA pipeline. Before calling, use get_zatca_status and confirm environment='production' for a legally submitted invoice; sandbox submissions are tests only. Standard (B2B) invoices require buyerName, buyerVatNumber, and buyerCity and normally clear; simplified invoices normally report. Always inspect the returned status: cleared/reported means submitted, generated/signed/pending means not yet submitted, needs_data/awaiting_buyer_data requires correction, and failed requires action.

buyerCity.description: Buyer city. Required for standard (B2B) invoices.

buyerName.description: Buyer company or person name. Required for standard (B2B) invoices.

buyerPostalCode.description: Buyer postal code. Optional for B2B invoices.

buyerStreet.description: Buyer street address. Optional for B2B invoices.

buyerVatNumber.description: Buyer VAT registration number. Required for standard (B2B) invoices. Must be 15 digits starting and ending with 3 (e.g. 310000000000006).

invoiceType.description: ZATCA invoice profile: 'standard' for B2B tax invoices (buyer name, VAT number, and city required); 'simplified' for eligible B2C transactions

issueDate.description: Issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format (for example 2026-09-07). Defaults to today.

lines.description: Invoice line items (at least one required)

discount.description: Fixed discount amount for the entire line in SAR (not per unit and not a percentage). Must be less than quantity × unitPrice.

unitPrice.description: Positive unit price before VAT in SAR

vatCategory.description: ZATCA VAT category: S=Standard, Z=Zero-rated, E=Exempt, O=Out-of-scope. Use S with 15% VAT. Z, E, and O require a valid VATEX reason.

vatRate.description: VAT rate as a percentage (e.g. 15 for standard, 0 for zero-rated). Defaults to merchant default.

vatexCode.description: ZATCA VATEX exemption reason code (for example VATEX-SA-32). Required for Z, E, or O; overrides the merchant default.

note.description: Human-readable note or memo (e.g. credit note reason). Optional.

orderReference.description: Your order/invoice reference. Should be unique per invoice to avoid ZATCA duplicate errors (BV-000001).

paymentMeans.description: UNTDID 4461 payment means code: 10=cash, 30=credit transfer, 42=bank account, 48=bank card. Optional.

name: create_invoice
